concept: Step Functions: orchestrating steps with retries and error handling
tests: Choosing a service to coordinate a multi-step workflow with sequential and parallel steps.
expected: AWS Step Functions: state machine with built-in retries, error handling, parallel branches and visualization. Triggers: "sequential and parallel steps", "retries and error handling", "state machine".
why_not: SQS only queues messages; Batch is batch compute; EventBridge Scheduler runs on a schedule but doesn't orchestrate.
